page.t: Engage arms the linked turret group and tells X4's auto-assist AI to fire at the selected target.
Watch leaves normal turret AI unchanged.
Release control before uninstalling this extension.
Group mapping is ambiguous; configuration is disabled.
Unable to return to the gunnery chair.

Choose a target for this turret group. Your current ship is excluded; friendly, neutral, and other player-owned objects can be selected, but X4's AI still enforces attack legality. Target brackets remain clickable after this browser collapses.
No known ships or stations are within this ship's radar range.
Choose the hull or a surface element. Selection changes the soft target; the linked group fires only if X4 considers the target legal to attack.
No operational turret, shield, or engine surface elements were found.
Select at least one turret group.

1. Tick the turret groups you want to work with. 2. Auto-engage watches them without giving orders; Direct-control lets you pick their target. 3. Ticking a group sets it to Attack all enemies. That and any other change here is undone when you get up, unless you press Update turret behavior.
Turret groups restored to their previous settings.
